title: Episode #14 – Sara Scott | CEO of Center For Legal Inclusiveness
metaDesc: Podcast: Sara Scott, CEO of the Center for Legal Inclusiveness, on building genuinely inclusive legal workplaces — and why it matters for firms.
bodyHtml:
Episode #14 – Sara Scott | CEO of Center For Legal Inclusiveness

Today I interview Sara Scott!

Sara is a veteran advocate for equity, diversity and inclusivity, both in the legal field and outside of it. From the start of her career, over 15 years ago, she’s been advocating for underrepresented communities. Including, but not limited to, advocating for foster children, helping same sex couples start new families through assisted third party reproduction and adoption, and most recently becoming the CEO of the Center for Legal Inclusiveness where she’s spoken nationally, trained over 1400 attorneys in equity in only 15 months, awarded the 2021 Top Women by Law Week, and sits on numerous coalitions and commissions where she persistently advocates for increased diversity in the legal profession.
